Proportions such as error rate and SLO attainment use the arithmetic mean of the per-run proportions with the t-interval clipped to [0, 1]; it measures run-to-run variation, not binomial sampling, so it is [0, 0] when no repetition saw an error. Results with a single repetition have no CI and are never trusted.
